verdict.rationale: Any service that collects user-submitted data can fairly be asked whether it lets users opt out of AI-model training, so the axis applies to a state filing portal like Sunbiz. The evidence pack covers only filing, annual-report and payment workflows and documents no AI-training policy or opt-out control. The robots.txt probe concerns crawler access to the filing host, not a user-facing data-use control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
